title: Learning and stationery
summary: Common study objects. The блокнот clue fixes its spelling; фломастер also accepts the equivalent маркер. Фарба is paint; барва commonly names a colour or hue, although dictionary meanings overlap. Рисувати can also mean малювати: it is not restricted to technical drawing. The наліпка note explains its dictionary stress variants.

zoshyt.clue: exercise book for written schoolwork (word beginning зош-)

osvita.clue: education as a system or attainment

nalipka.note: The native equivalent of the course’s borrowed sticker term. The inflection dictionary marks налі́пка; SUM20 prints на́ліпка. This board follows the inflection dictionary and accepts the equivalent label noun наклейка.
